scope: Standing Bardo National Museum exterior in Tunis: historic beylical palace, its garden arcade and the attached modern museum wing.

originalReview.notes: The photographer-dedicated 2005 garden view shows the pale historic façade, blue projecting timber windows and the public garden approach. Much of the historic building is behind vegetation.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with Qualla’s corpus. The published garden exit photographer’s credits template explicitly requests credit as a condition, so all of those photographs are excluded. The contemporary entrance and extension plan also lack unambiguous rights. The independently verified Anis Kochlef garden photo supports the blue bay windows and wall tones. The heritage institute and project archive document the portico and modern wing in writing.
